proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9209.2 *bābba, a nursery-word family, explicitly includes Bengali/Oriya bābā, Nepali/Kumaoni bābu, Shina bābu and Western Pahari bābo/babb. This selects the voiced-b branch separately from *bāppa; nursery-word convergence and regional borrowing remain possible.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10539 rakta explicitly means blood and compares Kashmiri rath, Shina rat, Punjabi ratt and related Dardic forms. Conservative rakt- and epenthetic ragat/rokot forms may involve learned or regional transmission; that route remains open. The link asserts the blood family, not uninterrupted inheritance.
